other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed or not in a regular/permanent position.
Age must be between 27 and 57 years, with a 5‑year relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and physically challenged candidates.
Minimum qualification includes a postgraduate degree (e.g., M.Sc., B.Tech., MBBS), M.Phil/M.Tech/M.Pharm/M.VSc, or Ph.D. in basic or applied sciences.
benefits_summary: Research grant providing a monthly fellowship of up to Rs 55,000 for Ph.D. holders (Rs 40,000 for M.Phil/M.Tech, Rs 31,000 for M.Sc.) for up to three years, covering equipment, travel and consumables, with total project cost up to Rs 30 lakh.
